items.title: 68515_Budd Johnson oral history interview
items.q: After the dance we got together and we went to Mr. Brown to be paid

ctx.x: In 19 and 27 we got a call from a guy by the name of Eugene Coy, that is my brother and myself got this call, after we were back from one of these --

Okay, could I just say -- the reason when I'm saying we were back, we had gone out on a tour once more to Oklahoma City, and we got stranded again there. These were the stranded years. These were when you were paying your dues. And we went into Oklahoma City, and well then a man by the name of Mr. Brown, who was going to chaperone us, and our parents let us go away with, and we -- our first job out of Oklahoma City was in Guthrie, Oklahoma, which is now the capital of Oklahoma City, and -- of Oklahoma, I mean,…

don't know, I imagine it's about 40, 45 miles from Oklahoma City. We -- in traveling there we were admiring the beautiful farms, and the big beautiful head of cabbages, and the watermelon patches, and the cantaloupes, and all the things, and the corn, and whatnot, beautiful farms.
